en: Explain the importance of effective communication to your career and to the companies where you will work
Explain what it means to communicate as a professional in a business context

big.en: Communication skill = the single most important career skill.

blocks.en: In any role (employee, executive, consultant, freelancer, entrepreneur) you communicate, collaborate and share ideas with people **inside and outside** the organisation. Communication skills may be the **single most important skill** you have.
blocks.ms: Dalam apa-apa peranan (pekerja, eksekutif, perunding, pekerja bebas, usahawan) anda berkomunikasi, bekerjasama dan berkongsi idea dengan orang **dalam dan luar** organisasi. Kemahiran komunikasi mungkin **kemahiran terpenting** anda.

Roughly **half** of U.S. consumers use mobile **exclusively** for online search

Kira-kira **separuh** pengguna AS guna mudah alih **sepenuhnya** untuk carian dalam talian

blocks.en: Dilemma = hard choice. Lapse = bad choice (you knew better).
blocks.ms: Dilema = pilihan sukar. Lapse = pilihan buruk (anda tahu ia salah).

q.en: Name the six ways effective communication helps a company.
q.ms: Namakan enam cara komunikasi berkesan membantu syarikat.

a.en: Building trust, closer ties to the community, client relations, increased productivity, marketing and sales, employee relations.
a.ms: Membina kepercayaan, hubungan komuniti, hubungan pelanggan, produktiviti, pemasaran dan jualan, hubungan pekerja.

q.en: List four features of effective business communication.
q.ms: Senaraikan empat ciri komunikasi perniagaan berkesan.

a.en: Facts not vague impressions; concise and efficient; clarifies expectations and responsibilities; compelling, persuasive arguments and recommendations.
a.ms: Fakta bukan gambaran kabur; ringkas dan cekap; jelas jangkaan dan tanggungjawab; hujah dan cadangan meyakinkan.

q.en: Name the six elements of professionalism.
q.ms: Namakan enam elemen profesionalisme.

a.en: Striving to excel, dependable and accountable, team player, etiquette, ethical decisions, positive outlook.
a.ms: Berusaha cemerlang, boleh diharap dan bertanggungjawab, pemain pasukan, etiket, keputusan beretika, pandangan positif.

q.en: Give four things employers expect from you.
q.ms: Beri empat perkara yang majikan harapkan daripada anda.

a.en: e.g. digital information fluency, organising ideas, active listening, communicating with diverse people, ethical communication, time management and critical thinking.
a.ms: cth kefasihan maklumat digital, menyusun idea, mendengar aktif, komunikasi dengan orang pelbagai, komunikasi beretika, pengurusan masa dan pemikiran kritis.

q.en: What is the “you” attitude?
q.ms: Apakah sikap “you”?

a.en: Focusing on the audience’s needs and viewpoint rather than your own, part of an audience-centred approach.
a.ms: Memberi fokus kepada keperluan dan pandangan audiens, bukan diri sendiri; sebahagian pendekatan berpusatkan audiens.

q.en: What is important to your audience (four items)?
q.ms: Apa yang penting kepada audiens (empat item)?

a.en: Biases; education, age and status; style; personal and professional concerns.
a.ms: Prasangka; pendidikan, umur dan status; gaya; kebimbangan peribadi dan profesional.

q.en: Name the four barriers in the communication process.
q.ms: Namakan empat halangan dalam proses komunikasi.

a.en: Noise and distractions, competing messages, filters, channel breakdowns.
a.ms: Bunyi bising dan gangguan, mesej bersaing, penapis, kegagalan saluran.

q.en: What are the three stages of how audiences deal with a message?
q.ms: Apakah tiga peringkat bagaimana audiens menangani mesej?

a.en: Receive, decode, respond.
a.ms: Terima, nyahkod, bertindak balas.

q.en: How can you help audiences RECEIVE messages?
q.ms: Bagaimana membantu audiens MENERIMA mesej?

a.en: Consider expectations, ensure ease of use, emphasise familiarity, practise empathy, design for compatibility.
a.ms: Pertimbang jangkaan, mudah guna, tekankan keakraban, amalkan empati, reka untuk keserasian.

q.en: What affects how audiences DECODE messages?
q.ms: Apa mempengaruhi cara audiens MENYAHKOD mesej?

a.en: Perception, selective perception, cultural beliefs, personal beliefs, individual thinking styles.
a.ms: Persepsi, persepsi terpilih, kepercayaan budaya, kepercayaan peribadi, gaya pemikiran individu.

q.en: What three things must be true for an audience to RESPOND as you wish?
q.ms: Tiga perkara yang mesti benar supaya audiens BERTINDAK BALAS seperti anda mahu?

a.en: They must remember the message, be able to respond as you wish, and be motivated to respond.
a.ms: Mereka mesti ingat mesej, mampu bertindak balas, dan bermotivasi.

q.en: What share of Internet users access the web with mobile devices?
q.ms: Berapa peratus pengguna Internet akses web dengan peranti mudah alih?

a.en: More than 80 percent globally.
a.ms: Lebih 80 peratus di seluruh dunia.

q.en: What are the two most common non-voice uses of smartphones?
q.ms: Apakah dua kegunaan bukan suara paling biasa telefon pintar?

a.en: Email (first) and web browsing (second).
a.ms: E-mel (pertama) dan layari web (kedua).

q.en: Name three challenges of mobile communication in the slides.
q.ms: Namakan tiga cabaran komunikasi mudah alih dalam slaid.

a.en: Constant connectivity, small displays, multitasking users, changes in traditional grammar, security and privacy concerns.
a.ms: Sentiasa bersambung, paparan kecil, pengguna multitugas, perubahan tatabahasa, kebimbangan keselamatan dan privasi.

q.en: Name three business benefits of mobile technology.
q.ms: Namakan tiga manfaat perniagaan teknologi mudah alih.

a.en: Enhanced productivity and collaboration, business-specific apps, faster decisions, greater audience engagement.
a.ms: Produktiviti dan kerjasama, aplikasi khusus perniagaan, keputusan lebih pantas, penglibatan audiens.

q.en: Technology can’t do three things for you. What?
q.ms: Teknologi tidak boleh buat tiga perkara untuk anda. Apa?

a.en: Think for you, fill in skills gaps, replace communication.
a.ms: Berfikir untuk anda, isi jurang kemahiran, gantikan komunikasi.

q.en: List the four general guidelines for using communication technology.
q.ms: Senaraikan empat garis panduan umum menggunakan teknologi komunikasi.

a.en: Keep technology in perspective; guard against information overload; use tools productively; reconnect with people.
a.ms: Letakkan teknologi dalam perspektif; elak beban maklumat; guna alat secara produktif; berhubung semula dengan orang.

q.en: Give three ways to guard against information overload.
q.ms: Beri tiga cara mengelak beban maklumat.

a.en: Use filtering features, manage subscriptions, avoid sending unnecessary messages, mark and save important messages.
a.ms: Guna penapis, urus langganan, elak hantar mesej tidak perlu, tanda dan simpan mesej penting.

q.en: Ethical communication has which three qualities?
q.ms: Komunikasi beretika ada tiga kualiti apa?

a.en: Includes all relevant information, is true in every sense, is not deceptive in any way.
a.ms: Termasuk semua maklumat relevan, benar dalam semua segi, tidak mengelirukan.

q.en: Name six forms of unethical communication.
q.ms: Namakan enam bentuk komunikasi tidak beretika.

a.en: Plagiarising, omitting essential information, selective misquoting, misrepresenting numbers, distorting visuals, failing to respect privacy or security.
a.ms: Plagiat, tinggalkan maklumat penting, salah petik terpilih, salah nyata nombor, putar visual, tidak hormati privasi/keselamatan.

q.en: Ethical dilemma vs ethical lapse?
q.ms: Dilema etika lwn kecuaian etika?

a.en: Dilemma: choosing among alternatives that are not clear-cut. Lapse: a clearly unethical choice.
a.ms: Dilema: memilih antara alternatif tidak jelas. Lapse: pilihan jelas tidak beretika.

q.en: What are the three elements of ensuring ethical communication?
q.ms: Apakah tiga elemen memastikan komunikasi beretika?

a.en: Ethical individuals, ethical company leadership, appropriate policies and structures.
a.ms: Individu beretika, kepimpinan syarikat beretika, dasar dan struktur sesuai.

q.en: Which areas do laws and regulations govern in business communication?
q.ms: Bidang apa dikawal undang-undang dalam komunikasi perniagaan?

a.en: Promotional communication, contracts, employment communication, intellectual property, financial reporting, defamation, transparency requirements.
a.ms: Komunikasi promosi, kontrak, komunikasi pekerjaan, harta intelek, pelaporan kewangan, fitnah, keperluan ketelusan.

q.ms: Yang mana BUKAN cara komunikasi membantu syarikat?

e.ms: Pengurangan cukai tiada dalam senarai. Enam: kepercayaan, komuniti, pelanggan, produktiviti, pemasaran, pekerja.

q.en: Discuss the barriers in the communication process and one way to reduce each.

en: Noise and distractions: choose a quiet setting (1)
Competing messages: make your message stand out and clear (1)
Filters: be aware of biases and check understanding (1)
Channel breakdowns: use a reliable medium and a backup (1)
ms: Bunyi dan gangguan: pilih tempat senyap (1)
Mesej bersaing: jadikan mesej menonjol dan jelas (1)
Penapis: sedar prasangka dan semak kefahaman (1)
Kegagalan saluran: guna medium boleh dipercayai dan sandaran (1)

Challenges: constant connectivity, small displays, multitasking, grammar changes (2)

ms: Konteks: lebih 80% layari web melalui mudah alih; eksekutif bawah 40 bergantung padanya (2)
Cabaran: sentiasa bersambung, paparan kecil, multitugas, perubahan tatabahasa (2)
Peluang: keputusan pantas dan penglibatan lebih tinggi (1)

q.en: Explain the four guidelines for using communication technology effectively.
q.ms: Terangkan empat garis panduan menggunakan teknologi komunikasi dengan berkesan.

en: Keep technology in perspective: a tool that can’t think or fill skills gaps (2)
Guard against information overload: filters, subscriptions, avoid unnecessary messages (2)
Reconnect with people: choose the medium wisely and use technology as an aid (1)
ms: Letak teknologi dalam perspektif: alat yang tak boleh berfikir atau isi jurang kemahiran (2)
Elak beban maklumat: penapis, langganan, elak mesej tidak perlu (2)
Berhubung semula: pilih medium bijak dan guna teknologi sebagai bantuan (1)

q.en: Distinguish an ethical dilemma from an ethical lapse and explain how an organisation can ensure ethical communication.
q.ms: Bezakan dilema etika dengan kecuaian etika dan terangkan bagaimana organisasi memastikan komunikasi beretika.

en: Ethical dilemma: choosing among alternatives that are not clear-cut (2)
Ethical lapse: a clearly unethical choice (2)
Appropriate policies and structures, e.g. code of ethics and ethics audits (2)
ms: Dilema etika: memilih antara alternatif tidak jelas (2)
Lapse etika: pilihan jelas tidak beretika (2)
Dasar dan struktur sesuai, cth kod etika dan audit etika (2)
